<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Slinger's Precision](/Classes.aspx?ID=20)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 105

**Class** Gunslinger
</column>

---

You have steady precision with guns and crossbows and can use weapons that incorporate them effectively. You deal an extra +2 precision damage with Strikes made using [crossbows](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=17) that don't have the [repeating](/Traits.aspx?ID=374) trait, and deal an extra 1d4 precision damage on Strikes with [firearms](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=16) that don't have the repeating trait.

 If you have gunslinging legend, you instead deal +3 additional precision damage with Strikes using crossbows that aren't repeating, and you deal an additional 1d6 precision damage with non-repeating firearm Strikes.

 If you are using a [combination](/Traits.aspx?ID=417) weapon whose ranged form is a firearm or crossbow, you use your proficiency with firearms and crossbows for attacks made with the melee portion of that weapon.
